_capture_method: user-provided PDF of live page (no HTML on disk); manually transcribed
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, traffic enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use. In addition, California agencies cannot run or generate results for searches regarding immigration or reproductive care.
acceptable_use_policy: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Elk Grove PD and is never sold to 3rd parties.
access_policy: All system access requires a valid case number and is stored indefinitely. This data is regularly audited every 90 days.
hotlist_policy: Hotlist hits are required to be human verified prior to action.

myth_busters: Includes Q&A on 2025 Flock camera bug-bounty incident; 2026 Condor camera cellular-network exposure; FedRAMP/NDAA compliance; ICE sharing denial; MFA enablement; and an SB 34 / out-of-state sharing denial citing CA DOJ Oct 2023 guidance.
